description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Applied Materials hires a Software Engineer to design, develop, and debug software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices. The role also develops documentation and test procedures, troubleshoots software issues, and communicates with customers about requirements, schedules, and troubleshooting.
Software Engineer II designing semiconductor-equipment software and database solutions, reusable libraries, and troubleshooting moderately complex defects

Responsibilities:
• Design, prototype and develop moderately complex database and software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices
• Designs common software modules and libraries for use across multiple products
• Develop software documentation and test procedures
• Troubleshoot a variety of moderately difficult database and software problems; design and implement bug fixes
• Communicate with internal and external customers for requirement analysis, project schedule and software troubleshooting

Requirements:
• Master's degree in a related field, such as computer science, information management, software/system engineering, cyber security or mathematics
• Proficiency in SQL, relational databases, .Net, C#, Operating Systems, Networking principles, Algorithms, Multi-threading

Preferred:
• 2 years of related experience is a plus from internships or other roles
• Strong conceptual knowledge of software engineering and a willingness to expand your capabilities
• A solid understanding of the industry's key business drivers
